bodies.topper: Every single hair is injected by hand into a wafer-thin nano skin base, so the parting falls wherever you want it. Fastened with clips, put on in seconds, and no one sees a transition.
bodies.topperBase: Every single hair is injected by hand into a wafer-thin nano skin base ({base} cm), so the parting falls wherever you want it. Fastened with clips, put on in seconds, and no one sees a transition.
bodies.pony: A fringe that fills your forehead and hairline in seconds, without cutting your own hair. Fastened with clips and removable at any time.
bodies.wig: The front lace line is worked so finely that the hairline looks like your own hair growth. Put it on, adjust it, and the mirror shows you again.

descriptions.menSkin: Hair system made of ultra-thin micro skin that practically disappears on the scalp. 100 % human hair, light, breathable and made so that the hairline looks like your own hair growth.
descriptions.menCustom: Made to your measurements: colour, density, hair direction and base are matched to you. The result fits comfortably, looks natural and stays discreet.
descriptions.menSystem: Hair system made of premium human hair with a hair length of {len} cm. Matched in the atelier to your hairline and your colour, so that no one sees a transition.
descriptions.glue: Professional liquid adhesive with a strong hold for hair pieces, wigs and hair systems. Lasts a long time, resists moisture and stays comfortable on the skin.
descriptions.solvent: Removes adhesive and tape residue from hair pieces, wigs and extensions quickly and gently. The citrus-based formula works within moments.
descriptions.tapeRoll: Double-sided tape with a strong hold for hair replacement systems, wigs and extensions. Holds firmly, stays inconspicuous and withstands moisture and sweat.
descriptions.tapeStrips: Pre-cut, curved tape strips for hair systems. Extra strong hold, resistant to sweat and moisture, easy to apply.
